amostra.article_body:
Beyond the Confrontation | Adam Spence of The Real Pred Hunters

The confrontation gets the attention. But what happens before the camera starts, and after it stops?

Adam Spence from The Real Pred Hunters joins Erik Lavigne and the Two Cops One Donut crew for a conversation about online child safety, accountability, and the realities behind predator-catching videos.

We’ll talk about what brought Adam into this work, warning signs families should understand, and the challenges of turning concerning online behavior into information law enforcement can evaluate. We’ll also discuss the responsibility that comes with filming confrontations and why protecting children has to remain the priority.

Join us live and bring your questions.

📅 Sunday, November 22
🕗 8 PM Eastern / 7 PM Central

#TwoCopsOneDonut #TheRealPredHunters #OnlineSafety
